agent_explanation: State-feedback controller prioritizes pole upright (theta stays ~-0.08 rad, margin ~0.72) over cart centering. Starting at x=-0.31 with v=-0.44 outward, it applies only small ~0.3-0.6 N force (far below 68.8 limit), letting cart velocity grow more negative to ~-1.37 m/s and drift monotonically to x=-2.41 beyond track. No pushes or noise involved.
